custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between three locations: the test location, location B and location C.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location, at location B (active there) and at location C (inactive there), under the same part number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make location C: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Locations in the left menu, then New Location. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425690 LOCATION C in Name *. Click Save & Close. To switch to it: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it.
  2. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425690 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425690-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00. Click Save.
  3. Switch to location B: Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  4. Make part A at location B: At location B, make part A again with the same Part Number, the same way.
  5. Make part A at location C and set it inactive there: Switch to location C the same way, make part A again with the same Part Number, then set it inactive there: on the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425690-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
